title: The drawers slide very nicely, evenly
text: The drawers slide very nicely, evenly. I have had a large number of various k-cup holders and this is one of my favs for sure.  I have a small amount of counter space and I will be honest, it takes far bit of space. The measurements given were accurate. While it takes some space it is so much neater/tidier than the random boxes on the counter.  I have a single cup, micro kcup brewer, so it takes a smaller amount of space.  The two together take up close to the same space as a regular coffee pot brewer... so I'm ok with it.  It has three drawers, as shown. I put the regular on top, decaf in the bottom shelf and hot cider, hot chocolate, hot tea in the center.  The top is flat, as shown and I put the stevia packets on top.  It is metal.  The drawers slide very nicely, evenly.  I think it will last for some time.  However, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Nifty Coffee Pod Drawer – Compatible with K-Cups, 36 Pod Pack Capacity Rack, 3-Tier Holder, Stylish Home or Office Coffee Bar Organizer, Black Satin Finish
features: COFFEE POD STORAGE: This compact drawer is compatible with K-Cups to store a variety of coffee flavors. The 3-tier drawer stores up to 36 pods at a time to always be prepared when brewing a hot cup of coffee in the morning. Coffee pods not included.

STYLISH DESIGN: Compliment any setting from your office coffee nook in the breakroom to under your cupboard in the kitchen with the sleek and stylish black satin finish. The modern and smooth surface is simple to clean when in a hurry to get to work.

KITCHEN ORGANIZER: Find your favorite coffee flavor quickly and easily without taking up a lot of space on your countertop. The drawer is perfect where extra storage capacity is needed, and you can place cups, mugs, creamers, or other accessories on top.

DIMENSIONS: The convenient space saving rack is only 7 inches wide, 7.75 inches in height, and 8.5 in length. Go vertical to save room for your coffee maker and easily get your caffeine fix without frantically searching through your cabinets.

HIGH-QUALITY PRODUCT: Nifty Solutions will solve your kitchen dilemma’s with high-quality and practical products. Keeping design in mind for your home, this coffee accessory is made to last, hard to break, and easy to clean.
Dimension: 7-inch width by 8.5-inch depth by 7.75-inch height
